text: {"C1":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent opens with a greeting, names the company and himself, and offers assistance immediately.","evidence":"Muy buenas tardes, gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza, le atiende Óscar Manríquez, para servirle. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar el día de hoy?"},"C2":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent asks about vehicle, prior coverage, financing, usage, and additional drivers before quoting, then explicitly recaps to confirm understanding.","evidence":"Entonces: Seltos 2026 GT Line financiado, cobertura amplia obligatoria, uso personal, conductor principal usted."},"C3":{"score":0,"justification":"No recording disclosure appears anywhere in the call, and the agent additionally presents the pre-underwriting price as essentially final, both of which force a 0.","evidence":"El monto queda sujeto a la revisión de suscripción, pero es prácticamente el final."},"C4":{"score":10,"justification":"A concrete next step is set with a named owner and a specific time, along with documents to be sent immediately.","evidence":"Y le llamo yo mañana a las nueve de la mañana para cerrar todo, ¿le parece?"},"C5":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent is courteous and warm throughout, lets the customer answer fully, and keeps the call efficiently on track.","evidence":"Cualquier duda antes de mañana me marca directo a esta línea y pregunta por Óscar Manríquez."}}
